title: Marketplace update - MSFS 2020 - New activities
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace just received a massive wave of new commercial aviation content! If you love highly accurate, real-world airline operations, you are in for a huge treat this week. We are breaking down 11 brand-new additions from VA Systems and Perfect Flight so you can figure out exactly where you're flying next.

To help you navigate your shopping list, we’ve split the releases into three distinct categories:

The Celebration Headliner: Perfect Flight's "100 Years of Lufthansa – A320 Edition," featuring an exclusive centennial livery for the iniBuilds A320neo and 12 immersive IFR missions tracking over 100 flight events across Europe (including Berlin, Munich, Nice, and Innsbruck). Compatible across MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024!

The Global Airline Schedule Wave: Winter 2025 real-world schedule packages for five major operators, including Sri Lankan Airlines, Air Baltic, Corendon Airlines, PSA Airlines (American Eagle), and Niki Air.

The International Hub Refresh: Complete commercial scheduling overhauls for five major hubs: San Diego (KSAN), Athens (LGAV), Tirana (LATI), Bangkok Don Mueang (VTBD), and Darwin (YPDN).

⚠️ IMPORTANT COMPATIBILITY NOTE: Before purchasing these airline or airport schedule packs, make sure you explicitly own the specific aircraft types used in the real-world flight routes, as liveries and activities require the baseline airframe to function!

Whether you’re stepping into the cockpit of the Lufthansa A320neo or flying highly realistic winter routes into Athens and San Diego, this marketplace update provides an incredible new playground to explore.

💬 Drop a comment below and let me know: Which regional schedule or classic livery are you flying first?

If this breakdown helped you narrow down your marketplace shopping list, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for more weekly flight simulation content! Safe flying, and see you next week!
